Hey, we just wrapped the post-mortem on that feature store outage from July 15th. The on-call notes are scattered in logs/incident_20250715.log and some rough notes in tasks/old_notes.txt. I need you to properly set up our project tracking system for the remediation work. 

Specifically: 
1. Create a proper sprint plan file (tasks/todo.md) laying out what we need to fix, with trackable action items and a section summarizing what happened.
2. Document the key lesson we learned from this incident — the config/code got out of sync with the feature store registry and there was no pre-deploy validation — as a structured lesson entry (tasks/lessons.md). Make sure it's done in the team's standard format so it can be tracked and won't get lost.
3. Log the actual production error we hit (the HTTP 422 from the feature store client) as an error entry (tasks/errors.md) following our standard diagnostic format.
4. One of our engineers wishes the pipeline could auto-discover feature view names directly from the Feast registry instead of hardcoding them in config — log that as a capability gap request (tasks/feature_requests.md) in the standard format.

All four files should follow whatever documentation standards the team uses. Please create them now.
